say:2:1720713002:1.text: Susan, you don't look well. Why did you come all the way here?
say:2:1720713002:1.source_cn: 苏珊婆婆，您怎么病成这样还要亲自跑一趟？

say:3:1720713003:1.text: *Cough*... I had no choice... Princess Peggy's birthday banquet is tomorrow, but I haven't finished the brooch for her gown...
say:3:1720713003:1.source_cn: 咳咳……没办法啊。公主殿下的生日宴会就在明天了，可是宴...

say:4:1720713004:1.text: *Cough* I ran out of solder and had to get more... If I work through the night, I might be able to finish the brooch in time...
say:4:1720713004:1.source_cn: ……咳咳，就在刚才，最后一点焊接胸针的焊药耗尽了……我...

say:6:1720713005:1.text: Don't worry about the brooch! You need to rest!
say:6:1720713005:1.source_cn: 苏珊婆婆，您都病成这样了，还管什么胸针啊！

say:7:1720713006:1.text: The banquet has been—I mean, might be—cancelled anyway... Besides, the princess can wear one of her old brooches. You should go back and get some rest!
say:7:1720713006:1.source_cn: 反正那个宴会也不会举办……我是说，也不一定要举办……而...

say:8:1720713007:1.text: Lady Penny here means you should take care of yourself.
say:8:1720713007:1.source_cn: 这位小姐的意思是，身体要紧。

say:9:1720713008:1.text: I... Sure, you can take it that way.
say:9:1720713008:1.source_cn: 我……你就当我是这个意思吧。

say:11:1720713009:1.text: I have the solder you need in stock, but you need to recover first. Fortunately, Magister Merlin is here, and we have all the potion ingredients he needs to help you.
say:11:1720713009:1.source_cn: 苏珊婆婆，您要的材料我有，马上让人给您包好，不过在此之...

say:13:1720713010:0.source_cn: 咳咳，梅林阁下，我这一把老骨头就拜托您了……

document:15:553:0.text:
Crush the <style="highlight">frostmist herb</style>, extract its juice, and pour it into the crucible.
Slowly add the <style="highlight">calming essence</style>, stirring clockwise until the mixture turns a pale silvery-blue.
Just before the mixture boils, sprinkle in the <style="highlight">pinecone powder</style>.
Remove the mixture from the heat immediately, then bottle once it has cooled.
document:15:553:0.source_cn:
将<style="highlight">冰雾草</style>捣碎，挤出汁液，倒入坩埚。
缓缓加入<style="highlight">宁神露水</style>，同时以顺时针方向搅拌，直至液体呈现出淡淡的银蓝色。
在液体沸腾前的一瞬间，撒入<style="highlight">松果粉末</style>。
迅速熄火，冷却装瓶。

say:25:1720713012:1.text: Ah... I feel so much better now. Thank you so much.
say:25:1720713012:1.source_cn: 啊……感觉舒服多了。梅林阁下，太感谢您了……
say:25:1720713012:1.male: Ah... I feel so much better now. Thank you so much.
say:25:1720713012:1.female: Ah... I feel so much better now. Thank you so much.

say:26:1720713013:1.text: I'd better go home and carry on with my work...
say:26:1720713013:1.source_cn: 我得回去继续赶工，为公主殿下制作出最精美的珠宝……

choice:24:0:1.source_cn: 把药喝下去，很快会好起来的
